description.narrative: Projektförslag med målsättning att förbättra vaten och snaitetslösningar samt hygienbeteende i slumområden i fem större städer i Bangladesh. Antal benficiärer uppskattas till 370 000. Sida föreslås finansiera 60% av budgeten, medan resterande 40% finansieras av WaterAid egna medel.

The objective is to improve environmental health conditions through improvement of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene practices in urban slums in the five major cities of Bangladesh. Total estimated directly targeted population amounts to around 370 000 people. Total budget for the five year project is 63 MSEK of Sida contributes with 60% and WaterAid core funds the remaining 40%.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The project targeted improving overall environmental health in these deprived areas through working with slum-dwellers, local authorities and service providers to facilitate sustainable WASH solutions given the unique vulnerabilities and systemic challenges of the urban poor. In its lifetime, PEHUP supported around 140 thousands people gain access to safe water, around 118 thousands people gain access to improved sanitation and around 246 thousands people received messages on proper hygiene behavior where around 73 thousands women and 33 thousands adolescent girls have been acquainted on menstrual hygiene practices.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
